title: Page 400
transc:
AH Caldwell Richmond Va  Wash Dec 2 1865
Happy Pharoah Arnold <unclear>Laurie</unclear> for Spunky spark
horace tulip B B Winder has been
sent by direction talbot college to horace
toby watsoned to you for trial yacht
The papers containing charges will be forwarded
by mail panther received savory Judge Advocate
spark yawl Ed Town send asst basket


R OBrien Raleigh  Dec 2 1865 
Webster Woods Dawson Sarah for Hornet T H
Ruger Walnut bronze J H Gee gladden by
end jingle rabbit to walnut toby loathed to
you for trial copper The papers containing charges
obviate frosted by humble chandler leveled fulcrum Judge
Advocate Galway Mastiff broach roanoke warm & pleasant


JR Gilmore Charleston  Washn Dec 2 1865
Wheel Snyder Harding for Boil transact Sister bronze
J W Duncan glance by end jingle Rabbit
to warlike toby loathed to you for neuralgia
carmine the papers containing charges olympic by humble
